measurement.memoryScope: Whole process (max RSS via /usr/bin/time -l). F32-expanded weights alone are ~0.86 GiB by allocation math; KV cache at 1024 tokens is ~24 MiB.
measurement.notes: Cold-start CLI: each invocation parses ~441 MiB BF16 safetensors and expands to F32. TTFT therefore includes model load plus prompt processing. Output speed = (32−1 tokens) / (t₃₂ − t₁) = 31 / 10.95 s, isolating decode from load. Decode is unfused (~240 backend interactions/token); T8 fusion is the planned fix. Prefill not separately measured (per-token path, same cost as decode). Correctness gate (the point of this iteration): llama.cpp b11046 CPU f32-KV oracle, 118/118 teacher-forced positions top-1 agreement, max abs logit delta 0.33, mean 0.021; 330/332 generated ids agree, both disagreements at near-ties (top-2 gap < 0.011).

evidence: Oracle gate: crates/executor-core/tests/oracle_lfm25.rs @ c3400ba (env-gated, MINIFIELD_LFM25_BUNDLE_DIR + MINIFIELD_LFM25_ORACLE_DIR). Capture tooling: scripts/oracle/ @ c3400ba. Oracle: llama.cpp b11046 CPU-only, f32 KV, temp 0, 6 prompts, artifacts hashed in tmp/oracle/manifest.json. Timing: /usr/bin/time -l on minifield-infer, prompt 'Tell me about yourself.', BOS on.
